title: Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Function-Calling
abstract: arXiv:2604.22985v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed to autonomously solve real-world tasks. A key ingredient for this is the LLM Function-Calling paradigm, a widely used approach for equipping LLMs with tool-use capabilities. However, an LLM calling functions incorrectly can have severe implications, especially when their effects are irreversible, e.g., transferring money or deleting data. Hence, it is of paramount importance to consider the LLM's confidence that a function call solves the task correctly prior to executing it. Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) methods can be used to quantify this confidence and prevent potentially incorrect function calls. In this work, we present what is, to our knowledge, the first evaluation of UQ methods for LLM Function-Calling (FC). translated_title: 大语言模型函数调用的不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益被部署用于自主解决现实世界的任务。实现这一目标的关键要素是LLM函数调用范式，这是一种被广泛用于赋予大语言模型工具使用能力的方法。然而，大语言模型错误地调用函数可能会造成严重后果，尤其是在其影响不可逆转的情况下，例如转账或删除数据。因此，在执行函数调用之前，评估大语言模型对该函数调用能够正确解决任务的置信度至关重要。不确定性量化（UQ）方法可用于量化这种置信度，并防止潜在的错误函数调用。在本工作中，我们提出了据我们所知首个针对大语言模型函数调用（FC）的不确定性量化方法评估。虽然多样本不确定性量化方法（如语义熵）在自然语言问答任务中表现出色，但我们发现在函数调用场景中，基于熵的……
tldr: 本文首次对大语言模型函数调用场景下的不确定性量化方法进行了评估，发现在自然语言问答任务中表现优异的语义熵等基于熵的方法在函数调用场景中并不适用。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification methods for LLM Function-Calling, finding that entropy-based methods such as Semantic Entropy, which perform well on natural language Q&A tasks, may not be suitable for the function-calling setting.
